title: Satellite mistaken for object near Jupiter on X
summary: Michael Shurmer tells of Satellite mistaken for object near Jupiter on X, about c. 2025 at Santa Barbara, California / X, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so on X, this happened like a year ago. On X, I see people going, "Oh my god, there's a weird thing going around Jupiter or Saturn." It's like, no, it's going around the Earth.

plain: A researcher named Michael Shurmer, speaking in a debate with a skeptic, says that about a year earlier he saw people on X, the social media site, excited about a strange object apparently moving around Jupiter or Saturn. According to Shurmer, it was really a satellite going around the Earth. He tells it as an example of how easily people mistake ordinary things in the sky for something strange.
